_comment: Falsification-corpus regression anchors for spectral-standard-v1. Pre-registered 2026-10-06 BEFORE any measurement (Lane C). Expected values are null until the first CLEAN gold-table run fills them via harness_spectral.py --write-anchors; a failing band is a result to fix in the instrument, never an anchor to move. Any post-hoc anchor change requires a dated amendment in this directory plus a major version bump (see PREREGISTRATION-spectral-2026-10-06.md §0).

physics_constants.note: d_s = 2 ln3/ln5 = 1.365212 (resolution A-1: the SPEC's 1.36507 is a truncation artifact; bands unchanged)

pinned_parameters.msd_metric: explicit graphs: chemical (graph-hop) distance^2; masks: Euclidean pixel^2
pinned_parameters.patch_side_amendment: AM-3b (advisor, 2026-10-06, pre-first-clean-run): 32 -> 128; finite-size window requirement t_hi/N <= 1/64 for the diffusive return-probability regime (disclosed: criterion strengthened after the 64^2 diagnostic showed rung-to-rung slope scatter at t/N = 1/16)
pinned_parameters.return_prob: fraction of walkers at start vertex at step t; zero-return rungs dropped (max 2, else insufficient)
pinned_parameters.series_ordering: consumed AS GIVEN; the module must NOT sort internally (FM-3b)
pinned_parameters.step_rule: non-lazy; idx = min(int(u*deg), deg-1); mask: 8-connected ink neighbors; isolated pixel stays (stay counts as a step)
pinned_parameters.walk_gold_level: canonical level 6 (V=1095); AM-2 replaces pre-registered level 4
pinned_parameters.walker_seed: harness canonical_json sha256[:8] forwarded as run_walks base_seed (AM-4)
pinned_parameters.walkers_amendment: AM-3 (advisor, 2026-10-06, pre-first-clean-run): 64 -> 32768; a-priori criterion: expected return count >= 32 at the smallest-P ladder rung (diffusive P(0,256) ~ 1/(pi*256) -> W >= ~26k); gasket closed-form P(0,256) = 256^(-d_s_true/2) = 0.0156 -> W >= 2058
